entries.notes: The vendored catalog renders this type's example digest in uppercase hex, and mdxfind will not read it back in that case, so the seeding pass could not verify it. mdxfind -z computes the same digest in lowercase for the same plaintext, and pinned to ^MD5UCBASE64SHA1RAW$ it reproduces that form; the stored vector is the catalog's own digest re-cased, not one we invented.
